name: CottageCore
summary: CottageCore is a cozy village-building sim. Players shape cottages and towers, choose their materials and colors, and add details such as doors, windows, chimneys, lanterns and ivy, with buildings that can even float on clouds. Deer, rabbits, sheep and chickens live, breed and age in a living ecosystem shaped by weather and seasons, while fifteen connected trades, from lumberjacks and farmers to bakers, keep the village supplied. The game offers a Creative mode with every trade unlocked, and a God of the Glade mode where a shared mana reserve, restored by happy villagers and decorated homes, powers villagers, animals, trees and supplies.
